items.title: Fill the one-door test with endpoints past peerPost that could be called illegally
items.box:
Fill the one-door test with endpoints past peerPost that could be called illegally.

DECIDED (Andy, 2026-10-12, on goal/G19.14)
- "make a goal that is only: fill that test with endpoints past peerPost that could be called illegally."
- The test is the one goal/G19.14 builds: a harness suite with one test id per pair of allowed door (peerPost, the bottom frame) and endpoint (a component of peerPost), failing on any stack that reaches the endpoint without the door.

FOUND at G19.14 (to be re-checked when the goal opens): besides presenceNode and postQueue, peerPost requires arrivals (also reached from hub, nodeCard, server), seal (hub, relay, relayServer), contacts (apiAuth, hub, server) and nodeCard (contacts, hub, presenceNode, relay, server); relayAuth and spiritErrors are shared by design.
